# Mediabunny 1.65.2

`mediabunny.js` is a bundled, minified subset of the unmodified Mediabunny 1.65.2 npm package, licensed under Mozilla Public License 2.0. See `mediabunny-LICENSE.txt`.

The complete corresponding source (including the `src/` directory) is available in the pinned public source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.65.2.tgz

To reproduce this bundle: `npm ci` and `npm run build:vendor` at the repository root. The integration code in `merge.js` is separate from Mediabunny.
